commits.headline: feat(pal,us2): match the release copies of func_002DC3C8 (#460)
commits.author: Fromnowheree
commits.body:
func_PAL_002DD0C0 and func_US2_002DD0F8 are the PAL and USA v2.00
copies of func_002DC3C8, the timed text page controller matched for
USA v1.01 in #451. Their instructions equal v1.01's; only constants
differ:

- PAL: text ids 0x16CC lower, and 50 Hz page times (150, 200 and 250
  frames where v1.01 waits 180, 240 and 300);
- USA v2.00: text ids 0xB8 higher.

Both begin with the same 8-byte residue as v1.01 (sw $zero, 0x50($a0);
nop), so they take the same measured entry offset (856, 8)…
